cover_a.sub: Number 5 is the one almost everyone ignores.

cover_b.sub: It's probably not your training. See #5.

reasons.head: You're not sleeping enough
reasons.sub: Short sleep makes you hungrier and can cut your fat loss in half, even on the same diet.

reasons.head: You only do cardio
reasons.sub: Without weights, up to a quarter of what you lose can be muscle instead of fat.

reasons.head: You sit for most of the day
reasons.sub: One hour in the gym can't undo ten hours in a chair. Aim for 8,000+ steps a day.

reasons.head: You switch plans every two weeks
reasons.sub: Water weight can hide fat loss for a week or two. Pick one plan and give it 8 weeks.

reasons.head: You're guessing what you eat
reasons.sub: Most people eat more than they think. In one study, people underreported their food by almost half.
